events.description: Walking along a winding paved pathway in Central Park surrounded by trees with autumn leaves.
Approaching and walking through a stone arch underpass.
Continuing along the paved pathway after exiting the underpass.
Climbing a set of stone steps leading to an elevated terrace.
Walking under a rustic wooden trellis structure on the terrace near the rink.
Standing at the railing of the overlook to watch people ice skating on Wollman Rink.
Walking through a paved terrace area with picnic tables and benches.
Watching the ice skating rink from the overlook railing while holding a green bottle.
Walking back through the terrace seating area past picnic tables and concessions.
Walking down a series of paved ramps with black metal railings.
Walking along the paved park path with trees, rocks, and buildings in the background.
